note: Floating screen: it is drawn through a portal into the page body and placed against the window, so the reference is the whole default 1280x800 window on the app's backdrop and every box is in window coordinates. A tab's right-click menu (stock-ui/tab-menu), opened from the tab strip (`tab.menu`), a sidebar row or a pane. Props are TabMenuScreenProps as components/TabSplitMenu.tsx works them out (what may be done: `canSplitNew`, `offered`, `inSplit`, `canStopAgent`; `extraItems` are the opener's rows: for an agent session on this computer, the three inbound-message choices with the current one ticked); actions are no-ops. The menu is 280 px wide (`maxWidth: 100vw - 16px`), fixed at x,y moved in to keep 288 px on the right and room below.
